spec_match.rationale: Runs the identical inputs through all three spec modes in one action: shortest truncates, longest substitutes positional padding (editable, blank meaning undefined), strict yields the aligned prefix then throws TypeError at the mismatch round; the padding getter spy proves Get(options,'padding') happens only in longest mode, exactly as the spec orders the steps.

interactive.rationale: Two editable inputs plus an editable padding list feed a single run that repaints three mode cards and the spy readout; changing the padding or emptying it changes the longest column live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the three modes side by side with editable padding and the getter-spy proof, all present.

edge_cases.rationale: The strict card is itself a failure-mode demonstration (partial tuples then TypeError, preserved in the cell); blank padding shows the undefined default; invalid modes/padding live in edge-lab by design.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6249068542164992 and the spec's mode/padding validation steps directly.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite assertions zip-default-mode-shortest, zip-longest-keyed-padding-by-position, zip-padding-only-read-in-longest and zip-strict-mismatch-throws-typeerror pin every behavior this matrix displays; verified passing on real V8 15.0.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven headlessly via CDP after the final edit (page-driver zip-modes, Chromium 141, 2026-08-16): shortest [mon,swim],[tue,run]; longest adds [wed,rest],[thu,rest]; strict shows the two aligned tuples then '… then threw TypeError'; spy reports shortest not read / longest read / strict not read; clearing padding pads with undefined; zero console errors. Screenshots: zip-modes.png (desktop), m-zip-mode-matrix.png (mobile 360, post-interaction, scrollWidth 360).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts mode-matrix-padding-laziness (longest read, shortest/strict not read) with per-mode read flags after every run, plus the shared banner-honesty assert; the strict TypeError is caught so the console stays clean.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; thrown cells use accent-rose on bg-stone (AA); the spy panel is bg-stone with an accent-blue border and charcoal text; mode cards use the shared border/paper scheme.

accessibility.rationale: Inputs are labelled (padding input also has a hint tied by proximity and id); each mode card's output is aria-labelledby its heading; the spy line is role=status; buttons/inputs meet 44px and show visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Mode cards and inputs collapse to one column via auto-fit minmax; scrollWidth 360 at mobile emulation post-interaction (m-zip-mode-matrix.png); feature-level responsive-check reports desktop clean, mobile OK.

openQuestions.title: Consider a per-input consumption counter in the matrix
openQuestions.detail: The three modes also differ in how many elements they pull from each input (e.g. strict steps the remaining inputs one extra time to verify completion; longest drains everything). Instrumented count badges per input per mode would make the consumption difference visible, complementing the closing-order evidence in edge-lab.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls table layout narrow mobile viewport no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Card grids should use auto-fit with minmax(min(100%,…)) so three-up desktop layouts become single-column on mobile without overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .modes and .inputs both use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, …), 1fr)); result cells use overflow-wrap:anywhere; verified scrollWidth 360.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce dynamic result updates screen reader live region output element
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Tie visual result panels to their headings with aria-labelledby and put dynamic single-line reports in status live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each mode card's <output> is aria-labelledby its mode heading; the padding-spy report is a role=status region updated once per run.

summary: Configuration/inspection angle: the options bag explored as a matrix — one run shows shortest/longest/strict against identical inputs, editable longest-padding, partial-output-then-TypeError for strict, and getter-spy proof that padding is only read in longest mode. Verified headlessly on Chromium 141 in the labelled spec-model path; every displayed behavior matches real V8 15.0 per the differential test and conformance suite.
